name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the telephony docker product (composes an app named rcore)
_comment: Common modules only for now on the Frappe side: the telephony module joins this template once it is extracted from control - hardware/telephony/frappe already carries manifest.json (app_type control: the PortaBilling client, the five telephony doctypes, the portal and provisioning APIs) and the four Telephony Subscription Plan seed records with their Items under src/fixtures/, but it is a control-hub persona tree, not a tenant module, so it is not listed in modules[] yet. The Next.js half is composed today: the sdks[] in core/utils/nextjs/composer/telephony.json are the telephony shell (RokctAI/telephony-frontend, app_type telephony) - Ray, 2026-09-09: "For telephony I suggest the hosting shape: a telephony_sdk landing half selling the Telephony plan category on control, telephony-frontend composed like hosting #6"; a storefront on the control site and nothing more, exactly as hosting.json. telephony_sdk is its home SDK (home_sdk: true) beside the three kernel SDKs; NO agent_sdk, whose integrations are unconditional (the agent: true flag at // @rokct-sdk-flags-start flips the shell AI-first) and whose plans query is the exclusion this shell's query mirrors. Merge order: hardware telephony_sdk 1.1.0 first, this template second, the telephony-frontend compose PR third.

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.
